description: Task 18: Build the Merchant Console pilot screens (Next.js). Create the complete merchant console interface with screens for: invite/lifecycle, Shopify setup, mapping preview, policy simulation, Razorpay status, readiness/scenario runner, manifest activation, transaction timeline, findings, kill switches, audit/export, suspension, and offboarding.
steps: Create apps/merchant-console/src/lib/api-client.ts with a typed API client that communicates with control-plane-api. Include auth token management, error mapping, and typed request/response interfaces for each merchant API endpoint.

Create apps/merchant-console/src/lib/types.ts with MerchantConsoleState, Screen enum, and all UI model types (InvitationStatus, ShopifySetupStatus, MappingPreview, PolicySimulationResult, ReadinessStatus, ManifestStatus, Transaction, Finding, KillSwitchState, AuditEntry).
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/invite/page.tsx - Invite/Lifecycle screen showing invitation status, acceptance flow, merchant lifecycle state machine visualization.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/shopify/page.tsx - Shopify Setup screen showing store connection status, credential validation, webhook configuration, and sync status.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/mapping/page.tsx - Mapping Preview screen showing product catalog mapping from Shopify to Counter format, version diffs.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/policy/page.tsx - Policy Simulation screen using simulateWalletAuthority from merchant-policy to show rule evaluation results, bilateral policy visualization.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/razorpay/page.tsx - Razorpay Status screen showing test account configuration, payment method availability, and recent transaction attempts.

Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/readiness/page.tsx - Readiness/Scenario Runner screen showing readiness check results (Blocking/AcceptedLimitation/Advisory/Expiring) and ability to trigger test scenarios.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/manifest/page.tsx - Manifest Activation screen showing current capability manifest, activation gates, and publish controls.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/transactions/page.tsx - Transaction Timeline screen with chronological view of all transactions, states, evidence, and outcomes.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/findings/page.tsx - Findings screen showing reconciliation findings, severity, affected objects, resolution status, and compensation commands.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/killswitch/page.tsx - Kill Switches screen with toggle controls for merchant/global kill switches, immediate suspension capability.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/audit/page.tsx - Audit/Export screen showing immutable audit trail, export controls, and data retention information.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/suspension/page.tsx - Suspension & Offboarding screen with controls for merchant suspension and structured offboarding flow.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/app/layout.tsx - Navigation layout with sidebar linking all screens, merchant identity display, and environment indicator.
Create apps/merchant-console/src/lib/identity.test.ts and update apps/merchant-console/src/lib/identity.ts for proper merchant identity handling with tests.
acceptance_criteria: All 12+ merchant console screens exist as separate Next.js pages under /app/
Navigation layout links all screens with proper active state indication
API client provides typed interfaces for all merchant control-plane operations
Policy simulation screen integrates with merchant-policy simulation types
Readiness screen displays all ReadinessStatus categories (Blocking, AcceptedLimitation, Advisory, Expiring)
Kill switch screen provides immediate suspension capability
Transaction timeline shows state transitions and evidence
Merchant console builds successfully: pnpm --filter @counter/merchant-console build
verification: export NVM_DIR=/opt/toolchains/.nvm && source $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && nvm use 22 && cd /projects/sandbox/counterX && pnpm --filter @counter/merchant-console build && pnpm --filter @counter/merchant-console test
findings: Build passes with all 14 routes (home + 12 screens + _not-found). All 35 identity tests pass. Had to fix body type (undefined -> null) for exactOptionalPropertyTypes and add explicit generic type params to request() calls in api-client.ts for proper type inference with Object.freeze.
